title: Lights on a road stretch at Mattibu, Gotland

plain: At a place called Mattibu on the Swedish island of Gotland, people go to one stretch of road to watch for lights that wander along it. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels about it as a known local spot, though he does not say when the lights began or what people think they are.
